text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As the end of Aoi's special transfer period approaches,
she takes her seat for another day's lessons.
text_block_list.orig_text:
交流生としての期間も残りわずかとなった、
ある日の授業中。

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
In today's class, you'll be working with students
from the high school division.
Together you will study the city structure of Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本日の授業は、
高等部との合同授業となります。
授業内容は、
ランドソルの
都市構造についてです。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
City structure... I've lived my life cooped up in the forest,
so that might be interesting...
text_block_list.orig_text:
都市構造……
普段私はエルフの森にこもってばかりだから、
興味あるかも……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's {0} over there!
We're sharing the same lesson even though we're in different years...
This is such a strange feeling!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
あそこにいるのは{0}さん……！
学年が違うのに
同じ教室で授業なんて、
なんだか不思議な気分です……！

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
For this special lesson, you will be preparing group assignments.
To begin with, I'd like you to divide yourselves into groups.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こちらの合同授業では、
グループ学習をしていただきます。
まず、
ここにいる皆さんで
班を決めてください。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Form... groups...?

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm sorry, did you come over to check on me?!
I think I almost passed out from sheer shock!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
わざわざ様子を見に来てもらってすみません……！
あまりの衝撃に気を失いかけていました……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
She said  we have to form g-groups, right?
It wasn't just my imagination, was it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
は、
班決めって言いましたよね？
私の聞き間違いじゃ……
ありませんよね？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how terrible...!
To think the day would come when I would hear those words!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんてことでしょう……！
まさかこんな言葉を聞くことになるなんて！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be looking quizzical!
Forming groups is the most terrible trial any loner can face!
The higher one's Loner Level, the more potent its terror!
text_block_list.orig_text:
首を傾げている場合じゃありませんよ！
班決めとは、
ぼっちにとって命に関わる悪魔の言葉！
ぼっちレベルが高ければ高いほど
その効果は絶大……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's group up together!
text_block_list.orig_text: 一緒の班に入ろー！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: Oh yes, let's! Hey, you should join us too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいよいいよー、
あ、
そっちもおいでよー！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Aaahhh... It's too late...
Groups are forming all around us...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あああ、
どうしましょう、
どんどん班が決まっていきます……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
B-b-but... nobody would want to group with me...
If I asked permission to join them, I'd just make things awkward!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもでも、
誰も私なんかとは組みたがらないはず……
仲間に入れてくださいなんて言葉、
迷惑に決まってます……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I-I'll have to resort to the ultimate loner technique!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こうなったらもう、
ぼっちの奥義を繰り出すしか！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Reading. If I bury myself deep in these pages,
I can avoid facing the harsh truths of reality...
text_block_list.orig_text:
読書です。
こうして本を読んでいるふりをすれば、
このつらい現実から逃れられるという寸法です……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... I hear nothing... I see nothing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ……
私にはもう何も聞こえない……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
B-but then what can I possibly...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？
で、
でも私には……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's the BB Brigade's objective?
text_block_list.orig_text: ＢＢ団の目的を思い出せ？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
To say bye-bye... to this lonely, bashful existence...
You're right, of course...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ぼっちと、
さよならすること……
そう、
でしたね……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: But this situation is far too high level for me to face!
choice_data_list: Why don't we suggest drawing straws?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも今の状況は、
私には難易度が高すぎます……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Drawing straws!
That might be a good plan!
It's a surefire method to ensure nobody gets left out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くじ引き！
それはいい案かもしれません！
あぶれる人もいない、
みんな幸せな解決策です！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: OK, we should ask right away!
choice_data_list: Hey, guys! Let's draw straws to decide!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ早速、
みんなに……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Huh~? Drawing straws?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええー、
くじ引き？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: But then who knows who we'll end up with...?
text_block_list.orig_text: くじだと誰と組むか分からないし……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Urk...!
text_block_list.orig_text: うっ……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: It's a bit late for that, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text: いまさらそんなこと言われてもねぇ？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 2
text_block_list.text: Isn't it more fun if everyone gets to be with their friends?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせなら、
仲良し同士で組みたくない？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Uuurgh...

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaagghhh!

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I knew it was no use...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、
ダメでした……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
I ran out into the corridor without thinking,
but I guess I might as well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
思わず廊下に逃げてきちゃいましたけど、
どうせならこのまま……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
There's someone else out here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
あそこにも、
誰かいますね。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I think she's in the same class as me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子は確か、
同じクラスにいた……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're... Aoi, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
あなたは……
アオイ、
さん？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Eek! She talked to me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！？　
話しかけられました！？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Eek! I talked to her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！？　
話しかけちゃいました！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Th-this reaction...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
この反応……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Could it be... Are you...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
あなたも……

text_block_list.name: Aoi & Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: A loner just like me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぼっち、
なんですね……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Ahh!
 Y-y-you're right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ！
そそ、
そうですね……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あのっ……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Wahh! Y-yes?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひゃっ、
ひゃいっ！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Would you l-like to form a group with me?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私と、
お、
同じ班になってくれませんか……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！
よ……
よろこん、
で……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
I, um, I felt so sick when I heard the word \"groups,\"
I sort of ran out here in a blind panic...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
班決めって言葉を聞いただけで目まいがしちゃって、
思わず廊下に逃げてしまったんですけど……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
But if you'd really form a group with me,
it would make me so happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうしてアオイさんに誘っていただけて、
本当にうれしいです……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
I did it! I really did it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……！
やった！　
やりました！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I managed to invite a member to our group!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか私が、
班のメンバーを誘うことができるなんて……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, {0}!
This is all thanks to your emotional support!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます！
{0}さんが見守ってくれていたおかげです！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: W-well then, shall we all go back to the classroom now?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それじゃあ、
自信をもって、
教室に戻りましょうか……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... It may only be a small one,
but I actually formed a group of my own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……
人数は少ないですけど、
ようやく私にも班を作ることができました……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy, I'm so happy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うれしいな、
うれしいな……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text:
Anyone still need to find a group?
We've got a space left in ours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだ班が決まってない子いるー？
こっち一人だったら空いてるよー！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 1
text_block_list.text: Oh, how about you? You wanna join us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そこのあなた、
こっち入ってくれない？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.orig_text: っ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: N-no, um, I'm already...
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いえ、
私はもう……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Y... you should join them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……い、
行ってください。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: A-Aoi?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ア、
アオイさん！？

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll be fine by myself.
I won't be at this school much longer anyway.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私の方は大丈夫です。
もうすぐ、
編入期間も終わりですから。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: But you should take this chance to m-make some friends.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもあなたはここで、
と、
友達を
作ってください。

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: N-no way...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Congratulations... You're a loner no more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おめでとうございます、
ぼっち卒業ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-I'm sorry... Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
ご、
ごめんね……
ありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Whew...
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ふぅ。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I regret it a little.
But I... I can understand exactly how she feels, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当は少し、
残念ですけど。
彼女の……
ぼっちの気持ち、
私には分かりますから……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for saying that...
I'm sorry. I threw my big chance away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます……
すみません、
せっかくのチャンスだったのに……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm totally fine. Finer than a fine thing in finery!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
私は平気、
へっちゃらのへーすけさんです！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
After all, I still have you, {0}!
The ever-reliable captain of the BB Brigade!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって私には、
{0}さんがいますから！
ＢＢ団の、
頼りになる団長さんが……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: Even if we're just a lonely group of two now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも結局、
二人だけの班になっちゃいましたね……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Aoi!
text_block_list.orig_text: アオイさん！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: You again...? What's the matter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたは……
どうしたんですか？

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
U-um, listen!
I-I, um... I asked them if you could join the group with us as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あのね……！
わ、
私……
アオイさんも、
同じ班に入れてくれないかってお願いしてみたの！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
And they... they said you could!
So, um...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうしたら、
大丈夫だよって！
だから、
その……

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
R-really...?! T-to propose something like that
takes incredible courage for a loner...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんと……！
ぼ、
ぼっちでそんな発言をするのは、
大変な勇気が必要なはず……！

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah. But I... After seeing you just now,
I thought I needed to be brave too...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うん。
だけど……
さっきのアオイさんを見てたら、
私も、
勇気を出さなきゃって思って……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
S-seeing me...?
Oh, no, no, no! I'm just a plain old loner...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私を見て……？
いえそんな、
私はただのぼっちで……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text:
That's not true!
You were the one who came and invited me first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなことない！
アオイさんは
私に
声をかけてくれたもの……！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I-I didn't really...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
そんな……

text_block_list.name: Female Student 3
text_block_list.text: Let's do this together, Aoi!
text_block_list.orig_text:
一緒に行きましょう、
アオイさん！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: A-all right...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっ、
はい……！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having given the gift of courage to a fellow loner,
Aoi joined her new group with a huge smile on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
同じぼっちの少女に勇気を与えたアオイは、
満面の笑顔で、班の輪に加わっていくのだった。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As {0} watched the two of them depart,
he found himself standing all alone in the classroom.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その光景を眺めていた{0}は、
取り残され、ぼっちで立ち尽くすのであった。

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.orig_text:
す、
すみません！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text:
We asked them if you could be in our group too!
Come with us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんも同じ班に入れるようにお願いしてきました！
行きましょう！

text_block_list.name: Aoi
text_block_list.text: I-I didn't forget about you, honest...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
忘れていたわけじゃありませんよ？
